description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. 
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. adjoe Ads is our programmatic in-app advertising platform that seamlessly connects advertisers and publishers through direct integration of our Android and iOS SDKs. Every ad decision happens in under 200ms across 10 million daily users, powered by real-time bidding algorithms and user quality prediction models that match the right ad to the right user at the right moment.

Engine Behind 120M Processed Auctions Daily

 The Ad Network team builds and operates the backend services that power adjoe Ads' programmatic advertising engine. The core challenge is straightforward to state and hard to solve: for every incoming ad request from a mobile SDK, decide within milliseconds whether it's a good fit for any active campaign — and at what price to bid.

To solve this, the team has built a Real-Time Bidding platform of 20+ Go microservices that orchestrate ad auctions at 1,500 bid requests per second, integrate with external demand partners via OpenRTB, and connect to ML models making 50 billion predictions daily across 600+ features to optimize bid pricing. The stack runs on Kubernetes, with Kafka handling event streaming, DynamoDB and Elasticache powering low-latency data access, and Prometheus and Grafana providing observability across the entire system.

DevOps Engineer

Who we are:

Pharo Management is a leading global macro hedge fund with a focus on emerging markets. Founded in 2000, the firm has offices in London, New York, Hong Kong and Abu Dhabi, and currently manages $9 billion in assets across five funds. Pharo trades foreign exchange, sovereign and corporate credit, local market interest rates, commodities, and their derivatives. Pharo employs a diverse, dynamic team of 140 professionals representing over 20 nationalities and 30 languages. Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Our mission is to rebuild legal research from the ground up. Lawyers still lose countless hours to fragmented sources, outdated systems, and databases that fight them at every turn. We're building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world to make that friction disappear.
We're a team of 45+ based in our Copenhagen HQ, Zurich, London, and Hamburg. We’re a small team with high trust and flat structure. We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.
Pandektes has raised more than €17.5 million and most recently closed a €13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

Mitti by SafetyCulture is a global tech company, just not the kind you're picturing. Our almost 1,000-person team builds tools that make work better for the three billion frontline workers who keep the world moving. description:
1958, Fondasol réalise avec succès sa première mission géotechnique.
Aujourd'hui, avec plus de 10 domaines d'expertise, le Groupe Fondasol est la référence en études et ingénierie conseil de la construction.
Géotechnique, hydrogéologie, géothermie, sites et sols pollués, géophysique, études de structures…: ses collaborateurs mutualisent leurs compétences pour aider les acteurs de la construction à bâtir durablement leurs projets.
Grâce à son actionnariat salarié majoritaire, le Groupe Fondasol continue de renforcer les synergies entre ses expertises, crée des outils digitaux innovants, décarbone ses activités…
Autant dire qu'ici, passion de son métier, engagement, évolution… sont des évidences.

En tant qu’ingénieur chargé d’affaires, vous accompagnez vos clients sur l’ensemble de leurs enjeux liés à la donnée du sous-sol, en solo ou en synergie avec les autres expertises du Groupe.
Du terrain aux logiciels, vous maitrisez la chaine d’essais, savez mobiliser les datas disponibles et les méthodes et outils de calculs pour optimiser et adapter vos études aux besoins de vos clients.
Prêt à relever ce défi passionnant qui conjugue expertise, relation client et innovation?

vous pilotez l'intégralité du cycle commercial : prises de contact, réponse aux appels d’offres et consultations directes.

description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.
We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.
Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.
Are you ready to join us?
Join our Customer Experience Analytics team and help build the data foundation behind a better customer journey at Back Market. You'll be working with a crew of analysts to serve data-driven decisions across the customer experience. We collect trustworthy behavioural data, build analyses, and help teams use data in their day-to-day decisions.

As a Customer Experience Analytics Engineer, you will turn messy data into reliable, scalable models that drive real business decisions. You'll partner closely with our customer journey, engagement and service team to make sure they can answer important questions about customer behaviour, engagement, retention and the impact of product and CRM initiatives.

This role combines hands-on data modelling with a strong understanding of business needs. You will…

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.
Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

description:
Country Executive

The Finance Function Is Broken. Everyone Building For It Is Boring.
Fast-growing multi-entity companies get two options: duct-tape a Frankenstack, or surrender to a corporate ERP and its consultant army. Both are bad. Both are beatable. Beating them market by market is this job.
Light is the AI-native financial platform for modern companies. Fast to implement, intuitive to use, smarter every month. We call it organic software. Legora, Lovable and Fuse Energy run on it. Product ships something worth shouting about every single week.
What we don’t have yet is someone who owns each market as their own. We’re hiring Country Executives across several markets. Tell us which one is yours.

This Is Not A Country Manager Role.
Most first-in-market hires get a quota, a deck and a flight. They repeat the London pitch in a local accent and forward complaints to HQ. This is the opposite. This is a founding hire for someone who wants far more scope than their years of experience would get them anywhere else.
No local playbook. You’ll be the person who owns your market, and within a year you should know its complexity (its rules, its buyers, its excuses) better than anyone else. It’s not a leadership title. It’s the seed of one. Do this right and there’s a real path: stand up an entity, build the team around you, move into product, or run the region as GM.

What You’ll Be Doing
Sitting across from finance leaders. Real conversations, not discovery calls off a script. You…

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers — the bar for entry is high, but those who execute are well rewarded for it.

Wil je graag snel aan de slag in de journalistiek? Dan is deze stage op de redactie bij Trouw iets voor jou. Trouw bereikt dagelijks duizenden betrokken mensen met de verdiepende journalistiek via print en online via de nieuwssite, nieuwsapps en digitale krant. Doordeweeks gaat het om 316.000 lezers via print en op zaterdag om ruim 430.000 lezers via krant en magazine. Daarnaast bereikt Trouw ook nog eens 2,3 miljoen unieke digitale lezers per maand via web en app.

Kom bij ons stagelopen en zie je eigen ideeën, verhalen en producties terug in print, op onze site of social media.

Wat ga je doen
Stagiair zijn bij Trouw betekent hard werken, maar ook zelfstandig meedraaien, veel schrijven en op pad gaan, meewerken aan de online promotie van je verhalen en je ontwikkelen als volwaardig lid van een redactie. Stages zijn mogelijk bij nieuwsredacties verslaggeverij/binnenland, buitenland/nieuwsdienst, sport en politiek maar ook bij de redacties religie & filosofie en duurzaamheid & economie. Trouw zorgt daarbij voor deskundige en intensieve begeleiding. Voor goede stagiaires zijn er ook na de stage ook mogelijkheden voor werk. Veel van onze stagiairs blijven na hun stage aan de redactie verbonden. Trouw vindt een diverse redactie belangrijk en streeft daarom naar een open werksfeer, waar ruimte is voor collega’s met verschillende achtergronden en opvattingen.

Wij zoeken een praktische leider die van aanpakken weet, rust brengt in de hectiek en het overzicht bewaart tussen de stellingen.

description:
Data die het verschil maakt
Data is pas waardevol als een organisatie erop kan bouwen. Als Senior Data Engineer bij LINKIT zorg jij daarvoor: je ontwerpt platformen die schaalbaar, betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig zijn, en je kijkt verder dan de losse pipeline. Klinkt dat als jouw volgende stap?

Je werkt nauw samen met analytics- en data science-teams om data ML-ready te maken en verbetert bestaande oplossingen waar dat waarde toevoegt. Als Senior Data Engineer maak je zo het verschil op zowel technisch als strategisch niveau.

Je werkt in de Data Engineering squad: een groep Explorers (zo noemen wij onze collega’s) die elkaar scherp houdt op vakmanschap en samen bouwt aan oplossingen voor complexe dataomgevingen. Kennis delen is de norm, niet de uitzondering. Om de twee weken kom je op vrijdag terug naar het hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag, waarin we tijd…

title: Senior Mendix Developer
summary: Je kunt uitstekend bouwen. Maar bepaal jij ook de koers? Er zijn genoeg developers die Mendix beheersen. De vraag is of jij degene bent die de architectuur neerzet, een businessanalist uitdaagt op…
description:
Je kunt uitstekend bouwen. Maar bepaal jij ook de koers?
Er zijn genoeg developers die Mendix beheersen. De vraag is of jij degene bent die de architectuur neerzet, een businessanalist uitdaagt op haalbaarheid, en daarna de developer naast je meeneemt in de realisatie. Dat is een ander niveau. En precies wat wij zoeken.

De uitdaging
Klanten als Defensie, LPMW en DGC bellen niet voor een simpele CRUD-applicatie. Ze komen met vraagstukken waarbij schaal, integratie en technische complexiteit van nature botsen met tijdsdruk en ambitie. Jij bent de senior die daarin navigeert. In de praktijk betekent dat: native B2B apps bouwen, custom widgets ontwikkelen voor complexe visualisaties zoals Gantt Charts, Java actions schrijven en architectuurkeuzes verdedigen die over meerdere sprints standhouden.

Je komt in dienst bij LINKIT en werkt op opdracht bij klanten. Die combinatie geeft je technische diepgang én breedte: of het nu gaat om verkeersdoorstroming verbeteren of waterkwaliteit monitoren, jouw werk heeft tastbare impact. Af en toe schuif je aan bij presales of een haalbaarheidsanalyse. Niet als verplicht onderdeel, maar omdat jouw technisch oordeel de klantgesprekken beter maakt.

Je plek: de Mendix squad
De Mendix squad werkt vanuit wederzijds vertrouwen en een cultuur waarbij verbeteringen worden aangemoedigd, niet afgewacht. Als senior heb je ruimte om anderen te mentoren en je visie op architectuur daadwerkelijk door te voeren, niet alleen te adviseren.

Elke twee weken…

title: Senior Functioneel Beheerder
summary: Stabiliteit is geen toeval. Maar wie is er verantwoordelijk voor? Achter elke applicatie die dag en nacht beschikbaar moet zijn, staat iemand die dat bewust heeft ingericht. Die de IT-keten kent,…
description:
Stabiliteit is geen toeval. Maar wie is er verantwoordelijk voor?
Achter elke applicatie die dag en nacht beschikbaar moet zijn, staat iemand die dat bewust heeft ingericht. Die de IT-keten kent, problemen ziet aankomen en weet hoe je een organisatie meeneemt in wat er speelt. Niet reactief, maar structureel. Ben jij die professional?

De uitdaging
Grote organisaties in luchtvaart, overheid en aanverwante sectoren werken met systemen die miljoenen gebruikers bedienen en verweven zijn in brede IT-ketens. Er is geen ruimte voor halve maatregelen, want een verstoring raakt niet één team, maar een hele organisatie of zelfs miljoenen gebruikers in heel Nederland!

Je gaat in dienst bij LINKIT en werkt aan complexe projecten bij een van onze klanten. In de praktijk betekent dat: applicaties beheren waarvan de beschikbaarheid niet optioneel is, complexe IT-ketens monitoren zodat integraties soepel blijven lopen, en functionele requirements ophalen bij key users om door te vertalen naar product teams. Je adviseert strategisch over optimalisatie en preventie, informeert stakeholders van IT-manager tot eindgebruiker, en begeleidt minder ervaren collega's binnen de squad.

BiSL, ITIL en TMap NEXT zijn jou bekend Je werkt er dagelijks mee en weet wanneer welk framework waarde toevoegt.

Je plek: de Functioneel Beheer squad
Je werkt bij de klant, maar staat er nooit alleen voor. Onze Functioneel Beheer squad is een groep Explorers die elkaar uitdaagt, kennis deelt en samenwerkt aan de…

Elke organisatie heeft een verhaal over waar ze naartoe wil. De vraag is of de technologie dat verhaal ondersteunt of tegenwerkt. Als Solution Architect bij LINKIT bepaal jij het antwoord: je vertaalt strategische ambities naar architectuur die houdt, schaalt en meebeweegt.

title: Senior Product Owner
summary: De backlog is niet het probleem. De vraag achter de vraag wel. Een volle backlog is geen visie. Een roadmap is geen strategie. En een sprint review is geen impact. Als Senior Product Owner weet je…
description:
De backlog is niet het probleem. De vraag achter de vraag wel.
Een volle backlog is geen visie. Een roadmap is geen strategie. En een sprint review is geen impact. Als Senior Product Owner weet je dat. Je hebt de complexe omgevingen gezien, de politieke stakeholders, de systemen met twintig jaar technische schuld. Je bent niet op zoek naar een functie waarbij je uren vult. Je zoekt een omgeving die jou scherp houdt.

De uitdaging
Bij LINKIT werk je als Senior Product Owner op opdracht bij organisaties waar de complexiteit hoog is: ministeries, grote corporates, data-intensieve omgevingen waar één verkeerde prioritering maanden vertraging oplevert. Jij bent de schakel tussen strategie en levering, tussen de directie die richting wil en het team dat die richting uitvoerbaar moet maken.

Dat betekent in de praktijk dat je eindverantwoordelijk bent voor backlog, prioritering en roadmap, en dat je die verantwoordelijkheid neemt ook als stakeholders tegengestelde belangen hebben. Je vertaalt abstracte organisatiedoelen naar concrete productkeuzes. Je stuurt op waarde én op compliance, op snelheid én op continuïteit. En je laat teams en producten structureel beter achter dan je ze aantrof.

Je gaat in dienst bij LINKIT en gaat op opdracht bij klanten in sectoren als overheid, finance en logistiek. De techniek, omgeving en prioriteiten van de omgevingen wisselen; de verwachting dat jij eigenaarschap pakt, niet.

description:

Iedereen praat over AI. Weinigen hebben het data-fundament eronder al staan. Als Principal Data Engineer bepaal jij hoe dat fundament wordt gebouwd: schaalbaar, soeverein en klaar voor wat er nog komt.

In een wereld die wordt gevormd door technologische ontwikkeling en geopolitieke spanningen, helpt LINKIT organisaties met IT-oplossingen die bijdragen aan een duurzame toekomst. Daarnaast werk je actief mee aan de Data & AI platformpropositie van LINKIT: samen met de directie en collega-leads (waaronder de Platform Lead en de AI Lead) zorg je voor een aanbod dat relevant blijft in een snel veranderend technologisch en geopolitiek landschap.

Concreet ga je aan de slag met:
Ontwerpen en bouwen van data-oplossingen…

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join: 

Every day, Airbnb hosts provide unique Stays and Experiences that connect guests with local communities in authentic and meaningful ways. These offerings are the core of what makes Airbnb special — creating connections and unforgettable memories for travelers worldwide.

The Connectivity team sits at the heart of Airbnb’s Supply strategy, managing the API Partners that power a significant share of our global inventory. Our connectivity partners — property management software providers, channel managers, and distribution platforms — unlock access to millions of listings and directly shape the quality and reliability of the host and guest experience. This team plays a critical role in growing, deepening, and shaping Airbnb’s partner ecosystem.

The Difference You Will Make:

As a Senior Partner Program Manager, you will run program management for Airbnb's Tier 3 connectivity book, including the long tail of unmanaged partners, and build the ecosystem partner program from the ground up. You are not managing a handful of accounts; you are designing and running the program that lets a small…

Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence are at the heart of the Airbnb product. From Trust to Payments, and from Customer Service to Marketing we rely on ML to ensure that guests and hosts have the best possible experience with Airbnb. 

Our ML team in Assistance Engineering is the team responsible for adopting the Agentic AI technologies to enable an intelligent, scalable and exceptional customer service experience. We are responsible for developing the Chat AI assistant, Voice AI Assistant and Human agent Assistant! The team is constantly exploring the SOTA Agentic architecture, develops and enhances various AI models, ML services and leverages tools including SFT, Reinforcement learning, Distillation, RAG/Search,  LLM evaluation and testing automation, feedback-based learning and guardrail for a wide range of applications in Airbnb.

The Difference You Will Make:

The Community You Will Join: 

We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead BizTech Enablement and Innovation (BEI), BizTech's solutions partner to the rest of the company. BEI works with Finance, Legal, People, Marketing, Global Operations, Policy and Communications, Design, and other non-technical functions to understand how they work, turn their problems into working solutions, and make sure employees know about and adopt the technology BizTech provides. The team also brings what it learns back to BizTech product teams and vendors to shape their roadmaps. You will report to the Director, Tech Foundations.

The Difference You Will Make:

This is a strategic leadership role within a large business unit. For the next 18 months, the team's focus is AI. You will own the company's approach to AI adoption and impact outside of Engineering, set the vision for AI-enabled work, hold functions accountable to measurable outcomes, and serve as BizTech's primary partner to E-Team leaders on AI transformation.

More broadly, you will lead how Airbnb's non-technical functions discover, adopt, and get value from business technology.…

title: Business Development Representative
summary: About Us  At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties…
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the…

Schema: how schemas are defined, tracked, and evolved safely across every system and engine.

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe's Money Management products (Financial Accounts, Treasury, Global Payouts, Issuing, and Capital) let businesses and platforms hold, move, spend, and earn on their money using the same infrastructure they already use for payments. APAC Money as a Service (MaaS) is a newly formed team, based in Singapore, responsible for bringing this product suite to Asia-Pacific markets, enabling global businesses and platforms to use these capabilities directly or offer them to their APAC users, and building the local rails, compliance, and partner integrations that make it all work.

None of this works without financial partners: the banks, card networks, and licensed institutions whose systems our products run on in each market. Technical Operations in APAC MaaS owns the day-to-day health of those partner integrations, existing and new, and the working technical relationship with the partners behind them. We sit between product and platform…

title: Senior Account Executive
summary: Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every…
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Airbnb Hotels team is a fun, fast-growing group leading Airbnb’s expansion into the hotel sector. Operating with an entrepreneurial spirit, this team combines the simplicity, product excellence, and guest-centered ethos that define Airbnb. This team’s mission is to deliver the smoothest, most intuitive hotel booking experience for guests, while helping independent, boutique hotels easily drive incremental bookings so they can focus on delivering the best hospitality. The ultimate aim is to help more people discover high-quality hotels, creating value for guests and our hotel partners.

About the team

Custom objects allow businesses to define custom data models in Stripe, ensuring Stripe reflects how their business operates. A business might have data that doesn’t fit standard Stripe objects, such as Shipments, Reservations, or InsurancePolicies. Once defined in Stripe, that custom data can be used with Stripe-native objects, such as Customers, Subscriptions, and Invoices. Companies can keep their existing system of record and bring over what their Stripe integration needs, or use custom objects as the system of record for that data.

Custom objects are the data pillar of Stripe’s extensibility platform, which consists of Stripe Apps, Stripe Workflows, scripts, and extension points.

We’re hiring a product manager to lead our custom objects product, which will make it easy for anyone to model, ingest, and use data on Stripe.
